dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent irregular 'C' and 'O' shaped structures are visible on the upper dorsal surface, featuring jagged outer perimeters with a sharp gradient from the dark skin to a lighter grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, bright-white asymmetrical pixel clusters in the upper-right region, with a single high-concentration area of solid high-intensity pixels on the far left lateral curve.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary annuli and the center of the large lateral reflection form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral with obtuse angles at the lower vertices.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, labyrinthine network of thin, high-contrast light lines connects the larger patterns across the dark dorsal-lateral skin.
